twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.hero_text: Besides your password you'll need a code from an authenticator app. Even with your password nobody else can sign in. Works across all Necsoura services.
twofa.unavailable: The server can't manage 2FA yet. Signing in with a code works.
twofa.step_scan_hint: In Google Authenticator, Yandex Key or another authenticator app
twofa.step_code: Enter the code from the app
twofa.backup_hint: Useful if you lose the phone with your authenticator
twofa.backup_ready: Codes are already created. If you don't have them, make new ones
twofa.backup_save: Keep them safe. Each code works once
twofa.regen_text: The old backup codes will stop working. Enter an app code.
twofa.disable_text: Your password alone will be enough to sign in again. Enter an app code or a backup code.
twofa.login_text: Open your authenticator app and enter the code for Necsoura.
twofa.login_backup_text: Enter one of your backup codes. Each works once.
twofa.use_app: Enter a code from the app
twofa.code_or_backup: App code or a backup code
twofa.err_invalid_code: Wrong code. Check the time on your phone and try again
twofa.err_too_many: Too many attempts. Please wait a little
twofa.err_state: This changed on another device. Refresh the screen
